description: Expected frame model of fixture.jsonl (written by: pit run bots/imp.s bots/dwarf.s --seed 24 --core-size 24 --min-separation 3 --cycle-limit 40 --replay testdata/viewer/fixture.jsonl) after each cycle 0..12, derived by hand from the bot sources and docs/spec/isa.md and match.md. Every viewer must produce these frames. Frame fields: cycle = 0 for the loaded core, c for the core after cycle c; owners = per core address, the id of the bot that last wrote the cell (0 = never written; bot cells count as written by their bot); executed = the steps of that cycle in execution order (ascending bot id), each the bot and the address it executed (empty at cycle 0); live = live process count per bot, index i for bot i+1: 1 at the start plus spawns minus deaths, with the final count shown as 0 if it is negative (only the final value is clamped, not the count after each event).
